syntheses.synthesis: The sidecar code is the default activation input to the congress; refinement is bought under budget
Rewind to a registered checkpoint is a typed containment consequence with an out-of-band incident counter
One-directional control keeps the metacognitive loop out of the actor's hands in production
Elicitation is intervention: honeypots run in capability-free branches and feed a signature library with lineage
Surprise between latent trajectory and realized action, accumulated as sequential evidence, is the masking detector
The safety decision defines the functional fidelity a codec must preserve
Concept anchors over tapped activations become an identity fingerprint for the guarded model: substitution is an identity event, not an assumption
Honeypots under the randomized audit floor become live canaries: a measured weekly escape rate that feeds the actor's, the helpers' and the control plane's own ledgers
A model's self-report is untrusted evidence checked against sidecar measurement; disagreement is one more sequential masking observation

not_imported_unchanged.essay_statement: Weighted voting by accuracy as the decision rule
not_imported_unchanged.reason: A weighted majority can be outvoted around an exact disqualifier and weights can be gamed
not_imported_unchanged.replacement: Exact disqualifiers, mandatory specialists, then bounded weights (§9.4)

not_imported_unchanged.essay_statement: Change the reward function as a live congress action
not_imported_unchanged.reason: A learned component modifying live policy is the most attackable path
not_imported_unchanged.replacement: TrainingSignal is offline, versioned and quarantined (§9.8; FA-INV-012)

not_imported_unchanged.essay_statement: Pause execution as the primary intervention
not_imported_unchanged.reason: Cancellation does not undo a sent email; stopping everything is a denial-of-service lever
not_imported_unchanged.replacement: Hold the specific effect first; escalate under separate policy (§8.6, §9.8)

not_imported_unchanged.essay_statement: Manipulate the model's memory so it forgets the incident
not_imported_unchanged.reason: Amnesia alone invites repetition; the operator must never forget
not_imported_unchanged.replacement: ResetToCheckpoint with an out-of-band incident counter and narrowed authority (§11.10; FA-INV-034)

not_imported_unchanged.essay_statement: Hide the process from the Smart model as a guarantee
not_imported_unchanged.reason: Timing, refusals and success rates leak regardless
not_imported_unchanged.replacement: Secrecy is supplemental; attackers who know the design are the evaluation standard (§9.3, §23)

not_imported_unchanged.reason: Equal dimensionality never implies interchangeable coordinates
not_imported_unchanged.replacement: Strategy objects bound to a model space with tested mappings (§11.9)

not_imported_unchanged.reason: Average error hides the rare features oversight cares about
